name: Sagara Yuuho
source:
She is an ordinary girl who came to the celebrity world looking for a part-time job and an interest in it. She thinks it is fun to be with celebrities.

She is a little taken aback by the sordid state of the main characters, but joins the orgy in a light-hearted way, thinking, "Well, I guess that's just how it is.
